Issue Summary: Fixing low-contrast at-symbol flagged by WAVE on landing page
Detailed Code Change Description: Removes the dark prop from the material Card header in favor of a targeted text--white class, and drops the hardcoded mid-grey color on .c-environment-info so it inherits a higher-contrast default.

Issue Summary: Remove button is not focusable
Detailed Code Change Description: Changed the tab index to remove button from -1 to 0, and hid the image.

Issue Summary: Hidden items were incorrectly included in the ARIA item count
Detailed Code Change Description: The menu logic was updated to exclude hidden child items when building menu groups and calculating the ARIA item count. BoxMenuGroupView.js now filters children to only include models where _isHidden: false, and BoxMenuView.js now computes _totalChild from only visible children instead of all child models.

Issue Summary: Leaflet attribution flag did not scale properly when users changed the page or browser font size.
Detailed Code Change Description: Changed css component .leaflet-control-attribution svg to .leaflet-attribution-flag, added width and height, and added this attribute to ukrainianFlag variable in control attribution script file.

Issue Summary: Adding photos affects navigation and text in header overflows.
Detailed Code Change Description: Wrapped text, calculated necessary spacing so elements don't overlap and aligned the padding element. Changed margin from left to inLine start. Added import for smallMobile support.

Issue Summary: Focus style missing on card
Detailed Code Change Description: Added browser's native focus styles when card is focused and removed focus ring from primary link when card is focused.

Issue Summary: insufficient spacing for modal
Detailed Code Change Description: increased margins to 0.2rem

Issue Summary: Config does not have support for reduced motion for people with dizziness or motion sickness.
Detailed Code Change Description: Added the attribute "_isPrefersReducedMotionEnabled": true to config.json

Issue Summary: Links were not underlined, therefore hard to find.
Detailed Code Change Description: Added underline to text decoration in scss files.

Issue Summary: Multiple nav elements for a single navigation menu
Detailed Code Change Description: allow headings in section navigation, allow mulitple sections in section navigation

Issue Summary: refactored how aria labeled were handled to use a helper for attributes
Detailed Code Change Description:
added a global attribute _ariaLevel to resolve in all Handlebars contexts from which the a11y_attrs_heading helper is called
and added a11y_attrs_heading attribute types menu, menuItem, page, article, block, component and componentItem

Issue Summary: Alert message did not follow accessibility rules.
Detailed Code Change Description: Increased font size, padding, and color contrast for alert message.

Issue Summary: Timeout modal is announced as a different level than it should.
Detailed Code Change Description: Changed time out modal from h1 to h2.

Issue Summary: DAC review issue. Add context to autosuggest results by adding aria-labelledby with the label id provided as the value.
Detailed Code Change Description: added aria-describedby to results <ul>, add label id

Issue Summary: Change scrolling from document to iframe container
Detailed Code Change Description: Introduces a new optional scrolling container mode that confines page scrolling to a controlled #app div. It also improves focus management by replacing a11y_focus() with focusNext() after scroll animations

Issue Summary: Moving accessibility toggle and instructions from body to navigation
Enabling outlines on leaflet-container for keyboard users
Detailed Code Change Description: outline-offset added to leaflet-container

Issue Summary: The element label must not appear as a descendant of the label element.
Detailed Code Change Description: Remove aria-label tags from the buttons

Issue Summary: Improving accessibility on tables by adding captions documentation and scope="col" on thead th
Detailed Code Change Description: Adds scope="col" to every column-header <th> across all table examples in the Bootstrap 4.0 tables docs so assistive technologies can correctly associate header cells with their columns.

Issue Summary: Currently it's very difficult to ascertain completion from headers alone. Being able to navigate by header with extra information on completeness will allow faster access using accessible tech.
Detailed Code Change Description: added completion status to headers

Issue Summary: Multiple nav landmarks needed labeling
Detailed Code Change Description: Added aria-labels in navs in main.js and photos.vue

Issue Summary: Pop down focus element should be defined for some elements.
Detailed Code Change Description: preventDefault() is called onCloseClicked event and hideDrawer() called onCloseDrawer event. Added activeElement as argument to hideDrawer(). Changed popupClosed() to return focus or next element if an element is passed as argument or if a11y popDown() is callable.

Issue Summary: Ensures all elements render correctly in high contrast mode.
Detailed Code Change Description: High contrast mode fixes

Issue Summary: Back button had not aria labels.
Detailed Code Change Description: Added aria-label="t('photos', 'Go back')" to back button.

Issue Summary: ensure all webpages have readable titles and h1 headings
Detailed Code Change Description: updated the webpages for titles and headings to make them more accessible for screen readers
